$comment: Category and service-type codes of the V1 catalog tree (Phase 1 03 §8.1, ADR-020). They are data: ESLint rejects them as string literals in apps, modules and UI packages (Gate 4 exit criterion, ADR-025 #11). Tests, fixtures and the seed are exempt. tools/architecture/__tests__/catalog-codes.test.ts keeps this list equal to the fixture tree.
